verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes official OpenAPI/Swagger specification files in a dedicated GitHub repo used to generate their SDKs, explicitly stated to let 'computers discover and understand the capabilities of the service' — this is a genuine machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: a direct download link from the main developer portal (probes show openapi.json/swagger.json 404 at developers.docusign.com) and independent hands-on confirmation of spec completeness/currency.
